title: FBR-ICAP Seminar on Income Tax Return Filing for Tax Year 2026
summary: FBR and the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan held a joint seminar walking practitioners through the current tax year's return-filing process.

title: FBR Responds to Tax Bar Feedback on Income Tax Returns
summary: FBR acknowledged feedback from the Karachi Tax Bar Association on the income tax return process and described it as a step toward closer engagement with practitioners.

title: FBR Announces Planned IRIS System Maintenance
summary: FBR notified taxpayers of scheduled maintenance on its online filing system — worth checking before you sit down to file or verify NTN status.

title: Federal Budget 2026-27 Finalised, New Slabs Effective July 1
summary: The federal budget team completed preparation of Budget 2026-27, bringing in the revised salary tax slabs and withholding rates this calculator uses.

title: FBR Encourages Manual Filers to Switch to Online Returns
summary: FBR extended facilitation for taxpayers still filing manually, encouraging a shift to the online return system ahead of future deadlines.

title: Clarification: Filer Status Based on 2024 Return Filings
summary: FBR clarified that a taxpayer's Active Taxpayer List status for the relevant period is determined by whether their 2024 return was filed — directly affects who gets the lower filer WHT rate.
